author: Akien
prose:
Akien, 2026-10-29, in chat, after CC listed what the rehearsal reader is handed beyond the ticket (instructions, voyage craft, already landed, eight chart packets, two charters; 57,870 chars on 7a31059daa23):

"got it. i see some places we could simplify. instructions, would it make sense to add this? 'You are a build simulator here to identify what's missing' you kinda say that but not that directly. then we can leave off the voyage part. the ticket is supposed to be a build plan (perhaps not implemented yet?) so no longer has "decisions" per se, but the resulting plan steps. Yes? then we don't need already landed, chart or charter, what do you think? it doesn't need to 'fit in to our build process' it just needs to say 'i got stopped here' or 'xyz is missing' otherwise the intention of the instructions you have is good. do you think that could work?"

Then, after CC agreed, proposed keeping looks_at and step ids, and called it its own ticket:

"almost: looks at: we should be telling it what exists and what doesn't before hand. i like your step ids. i agree it's it's own ticket. take it in the order you want, but it sounds like this would unblock you."
